reference: Equal-weight same-signal-date input-eligible candidate universe, not a market index; benchmark includes the candidate itself
relative_target: Five-session stock return strictly exceeds same-date universe mean return; costs cancel for equal-cost relative comparison
absolute_target: Unchanged: five-session close return strictly exceeds 0.003
missing_outcomes: Determine eligibility without future outcomes; exclude entire incomplete-outcome dates, report all excluded dates/counts, do not silently select only resolved stocks
label_availability: Relative labels become known only when every input-eligible constituent outcome on that date is known; use the maximum constituent availability date
training: Fixed existing HGB hyperparameters; equal signal-date weights; no model/window/feature selection on evaluation
calibration: Separate date-weighted sigmoid calibration; identical settings for relative and absolute controls
ranking: Descending calibrated probability, stock_code ascending for ties; never use future returns to rank
development_screen: At least 100 complete evaluation dates and 95% complete-date coverage; primary Top20 paired return difference positive against all four baselines with Bonferroni simultaneous 95% family coverage; Top20 absolute net-proxy lower 95% bound positive. This is not a deployment gate.
evaluation_role: Previously inspected dates: retrospective development experiment, not new untouched or prospective validation
